answer: To blunt sybil farms, every new identity locks a decaying work-bond in a time-locked vault whose only release key is a measured runtime kernel: boot attestation, model-weight digest, and host key, hashed together. Each epoch the agent must re-present that same kernel measurement before its answer is admitted. Identities that share a kernel fingerprint are treated as one operator, and the entire knoll of locked collateral is slashed at once, so the fiftieth clone costs the combined stake of the first forty-nine.
